educates about the risks of bronchospasm with NSAID use and recommends acetaminophen instead. Katrice’s 
parents verbalize understanding and are receptive to education. 
3 . Which of the following statements by the client indicates additional diet instruction is needed? 
a. “I will try to cut back on the amount of fast food I eat.” 
b. “I am going to get some deli meat so I can make sandwiches to eat at school.” 
c. “I’m going to try to eat sandwiches made with whole grain tortillas.” 
d. “I will try to eat baked chicken instead of fried.” 
4 . Which of the following breakfast options is the best choice for the client? 
a. A whey protein shake 
b. Two strawberry toaster tarts 
c. Pancakes and bacon 
d. Whole grain toast
